name: Homokkomárom (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Homokkomárom (a quartered blue and green shield with a crown, a bunch of grapes and a church) above the name HOMOKKOMÁROM in green.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
